sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their most recent defeat. Despite that loss, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, and they'll be strong favorites against bottom-placed Alsager, who have won just once all season and are winless in their last eight.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture that should favor the visitors given Stafford's superior league position and recent form. The title race tightens with AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) traveling to Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) in a direct top-six clash, while Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a meeting of mid-table sides separated by just six points. Bilston Town welcome bottom-dweller Foley Meir in what should be a comfortable home fixture for the fifth-place team. Barnton host Shawbury United in a contest between sides on divergent trajectories—Barnton have won their last two games while Shawbury are in freefall with six consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town face New Mills in a mid-table affair, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement battle between the 17th and 18th-place teams. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a lower-mid-table encounter, and Widnes Town—winless and bottom with just 2 points—travel to Brereton Social in Saturday's most lopsided matchup on paper. A midweek fixture follows on Wednesday 7 October when Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community at 19:45.
